verdict.rationale: A payments and commerce platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights from merchant data, so this axis applies. The evidence pack shows no in-product insights or suggestions. What it documents is agent checkout rails (ACP, UCP, Store Sync, cart APIs) and an MCP server plus agent toolkit that let external AI clients query orders, transactions and disputes. Any analysis there comes from the third-party agent, not from PayPal's product.
